auditItems.title: Hotspawn lobby and match-detail clocks use different display zones
auditItems.details: For the three audited matches, the lobby/book pages show a clock four hours earlier than the Hotspawn match-detail page. The corresponding Polymarket market descriptions explicitly label the earlier times as ET, while the official market-data records provide an eventStartTime ending in Z. The UTC column below uses only that explicit Z timestamp; raw Hotspawn display text is retained. Future fixtures without explicit timezone metadata are not converted.

auditItems.title: Repository baseline is not the complete Hotspawn lobby
auditItems.details: Only three manually checked fixtures are included in the seed snapshot. The automated refresh must succeed before the data can be called complete. Any unmatched bookmaker or exchange field remains blank; the site makes no Hotspawn-derived probability estimate.

auditItems.title: ex-Keyd Stars vs Galorys has an exchange price but no verified sportsbook quote
auditItems.details: The Polymarket match-winner contract has a direct official price. No two-sided bookmaker quote was confirmed for this row, so the bookmaker fair-probability fields are blank. The exchange price is displayed in a separate column and is not substituted for a sportsbook line.
